gaps.explanation: Statement (Exhibit H, p6) Total operating disbursements/depreciation 13,532 (Water 6,382 + Sewer 7,150) includes Depreciation 2,631 (Water 1,781 + Sewer 850) and has no capital purchases. The detail lines come from Schedule 3 (p10), budgetary cash basis: Water 7,006 + Sewer 6,300 = 13,306. Schedule 4 (p11) prints the reconciliation: 13,532 - depreciation 2,631 = 10,901, plus Purchase of capital assets 2,405 (budgetary basis only, not on the modified cash statement) = 13,306; printed change adjustment 226. Per fund: Water 6,382 - 1,781 + 2,405 = 7,006; Sewer 7,150 - 850 = 6,300. Gap 13,532 - 13,306 = 226 = 2,631 - 2,405 exactly. Printed basis difference; no fix.
